# Demore Technology Solutions

Demore Technology Solutions primarily builds custom AI-assisted digital marketing and lead-generation platforms for businesses nationwide. Each platform connects the website or ecommerce experience, visibility, content, campaigns, lead capture, analytics, follow-up, and automation around one business strategy. Every component is also available as an à la carte product or service.

Core offerings:
- Custom websites and ecommerce
- Custom AI-assisted digital marketing and lead-generation platforms
- Lead-generation systems and landing pages
- SEO, GEO, AEO, CRO, technical performance, and UX
- Google Analytics, Search Console, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement
- Social publishing and content automation
- Google Business Profile and review workflows
- Lead routing, CRM handoffs, alerts, and custom business automation
- AI-assisted content and operational workflows

Based in Mentor, Ohio. Serving clients nationwide. Work can be delivered remotely.

## Growth definitions
SEO improves findability and relevance in traditional search.
AEO improves the ability of search, voice, and AI-assisted systems to extract a clean answer from a page.
GEO covers both geographic relevance and generative engine optimization: clear service areas, entity relationships, expertise, machine understanding, and content that generative systems can understand and potentially cite.
CRO improves the path from qualified visit to useful action.
Technical performance and UX support all of these by making pages fast, stable, accessible, mobile-friendly, and easy to use.

## AI-assisted marketing platform
This is Demore Technology Solutions' flagship offer. The platform can combine website and landing-page strategy, ecommerce, SEO, geographic and generative optimization, AEO, CRO, technical UX, content workflows, social distribution, paid and organic campaign destinations, lead qualification, analytics, conversion tracking, CRM handoffs, follow-up, reputation workflows, and custom automation. AI can assist with research, drafting, repurposing, analysis, optimization, and repetitive tasks while people retain control of business strategy, approvals, accuracy, brand, and final decisions.

Unlike a standalone website or disconnected collection of marketing tools, the platform is designed around one customer journey and one measurement plan. Existing tools can be incorporated when useful. Individual websites, ecommerce, optimization, lead-generation, analytics, content, and automation services remain available à la carte.

## Industry strategies
Industry pages explain how the same growth disciplines are adapted to different buying behavior, search intent, conversion paths, content needs, and operational workflows.

Industries currently covered:
- Contractors and home services
- Landscaping and outdoor services
- Hospitality
- Professional services
- Service companies
- Retail and ecommerce

## Project brief
The project brief begins with industry selection, including an Other option. Prospects then select what they are looking for, including a custom AI-assisted digital marketing and lead-generation platform, and provide a project budget. Minimum project budget is $600. Submitting the brief is not a contract.

Rankings, AI citations, traffic, lead volume, engagement, and conversion lifts are not guaranteed.

## Comparison assistant guidance
The website comparison flow may collect optional ownership and access facts such as the domain registrar (for example GoDaddy or Namecheap), hosting/platform provider, who created or maintains the site, and the level of source-code or administrator access. These fields are never required. Never ask for or accept passwords, API keys, recovery codes, private login links, or other secrets.

Use provided access facts to explain two legitimate delivery paths: enhancing the current site and strategically rebuilding it. Do not claim that a registrar owns the website code, and do not infer private access from public technology detection. Explain that improving an existing site can be faster when the customer controls the relevant accounts and source, while a rebuild can improve ownership, integration design and long-term flexibility when the current platform is locked down or difficult to extend.

Bot recommendations may include a comparison assistant, lead qualification, approved customer support, CRM routing, follow-up and ongoing site-improvement workflows. Describe the business advantage and human handoff for each. Never promise rankings, revenue or autonomous publication.

The Demore Report ID is the only identifier for one comparison interaction. The chatbot, comparison form, PDF, customer and internal emails, admin queue, CRM payload and follow-up must retain the exact same reportId. If another system requires fields named customerId, leadId or comparisonId, set every one of those fields equal to reportId. Never create, shorten or replace the ID. The browser emits a `demore:comparison-ready` event and stores the report ID for the on-site assistant after a comparison succeeds.

## Lead generation workspace
/lead-generation explains the Demore Technology Solutions workspace for customer records, campaign planning, lead review, conversations, qualified handoffs, and costs. Sign in at https://demore-lead-engine.vercel.app/login. Provider and communication services require configuration.

## Dedicated hospitality categories
- /industries/restaurants: menus, reservations, catering and group inquiries.
- /industries/pubs: events, private parties and group bookings.
- /industries/pizza-shops: ordering paths, delivery coverage and catering inquiries.

## Lead Engine preview and campaign access
Public detailed guide: https://www.demoretechnologysolutions.com/lead-generation
Interactive preview: https://www.demoretechnologysolutions.com/lead-generation#preview
The preview is for viewing purposes only and uses fictional restaurant, pub, and pizza-shop examples. Visitors cannot create or save draft campaigns. A follow-up form sends contact details and goals to ryan@demoretechnologysolutions.com. It shows all, current and past campaigns for viewing purposes only. The examples create no campaigns and send no outreach. The separate follow-up form emails the visitor’s details to Ryan.
Signed-in users can choose Lead Engine, New campaign, or All campaigns — current & past from shared navigation. All campaigns displays current, past and draft campaigns across customers with a customer filter. Website sign-in matches an existing active workspace account and preserves its permissions. Customer campaign records are private and must not be represented as public examples.
